# coolify_destination (Resource)

A Docker network (destination) on a Coolify server. Resources deploy into a destination; servers get a default one when validated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_destination" "isolated" {
  server_uuid = coolify_server.example.uuid
  network     = "isolated-net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network` (String) Docker network name. Changing it forces replacement.
- `server_uuid` (String) UUID of the server hosting the network. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Display name. Defaults to `<server>-<network>`.
- `type` (String) `standalone` or `swarm`. Must match the server type; defaults to the server's expected type.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
